lines.text: God says He brought them out of Egypt and tells them to have no other gods before Him.
God forbids making an idol or bowing down to it, for He is a jealous God.
God tells them to do no work on the Sabbath, because He made everything in seven days.
God commands honoring father and mother, and forbids murder, adultery, stealing, false witness and coveting.
The people tremble at the thunder and smoke, so they ask Aaron to speak to them instead of God.
